hub.title: When rejection hurts too much
hub.quote: If even a small glance feels like the end of the world, you're not too sensitive. Your nervous system works differently.
hub.safety_note: This section helps distinguish RSD reactions from actual workplace bullying. Both can be true simultaneously.

what.title: What is RSD?
what.subtitle: Rejection Sensitive Dysphoria
what.definition: Rejection Sensitive Dysphoria (RSD) is a neurological trait that makes the experience of rejection extremely painful. It's not weakness – it's a neurological difference.
what.stat1: 99% of adults with ADHD experience RSD

workplace.title: RSD at work
workplace.subtitle: How it shows in daily life
workplace.fear_feedback: Fear of feedback can block career paths and development

scenario.title: Same situation, different interpretations
scenario.instruction: How RSD can color an ordinary workday
scenario.insight: Both interpretations can feel real. RSD tools help test which is more likely.
